title: Yarn Berry resolution shared-kit@workspace:packages/shared-kit vs registry tarball
notes: Berry lockfile descriptors include shared-kit@workspace:* and resolution shared-kit@workspace:packages/shared-kit with linkType soft. That is a workspace identity. Registry 2.1.0 of the same name is not.

decisionNotes: Yarn Berry resolution is shared-kit@workspace:packages/shared-kit (linkType soft).
workspace: in the descriptor is the identity, not npm registry shared-kit@2.1.0.
Yarn lockfile parsed heuristically (no @yarnpkg/lockfile). Unparseable ⇒ unknown.
Identity conflict ⇒ unknown (rules 3 and 5). A newer version is not itself a break.
